title: Terry and Linda Jamison: one person split into twins

tellings.quote: One case of this that's very prominent is Terry and Linda Jameson. Uh they are these identical twins who are also psychics, but they report having been the same person before they were separated at Earth, as they call it.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Terry and Linda Jamison, identical twin sisters who are also psychics. According to Jorjani, the twins say they were one single person before being split apart on arrival on Earth, which, if true, would mean a soul can come from elsewhere and divide in two.
